intro: Uganda has about 50 million people and one of the youngest populations on Earth.

chapters.title: People
text: The Baganda are the largest group. English and Swahili are official, and Luganda is widely spoken. Most people are Christian, with a Muslim minority.
Uganda hosts over a million refugees, more than any other African country, mainly from South Sudan and DR Congo.

chapters.title: Kampala
text: Kampala, the capital, is built on hills, famous for its boda-boda motorbike taxis.

keyTerms.meaning: Someone forced to flee their country.
